# Part-time Analyst - Corporate Finance (Copenhagen and Aarhus)

EY-Parthenon

## Ready to launch your career in M&A and Corporate Finance?

Join EY-Parthenon Corporate Finance and kick-start your career in investment banking while you're still studying.

## The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

As a Part-time Analyst, you will work alongside experienced colleagues on live M&A transactions and related business development initiatives. From day one, you will take on meaningful responsibilities and gain exposure to many aspects of the deal-making process. You will become part of a high-performing and close-knit team where learning, collaboration, and professional development are central to everything we do.

We are proud to be an integral part of the Danish investment banking landscape, helping business owners navigate some of the most important decisions of their lives. Every day, we strive to balance the three pillars that define our team culture: i) having fun, ii) developing ourselves, and iii) succeeding together on our transactions.

You will support the team on several key M&A tasks, including:

* Preparation of marketing material including pitch presentations, information memoranda, management presentations and client meeting materials
* Assisting in preparing corporate valuations (DCF, LBO, multiples, operational modelling, etc.)
* Peer group/buyer/target screenings
* Financial statement analysis
* Market research and analysis for internal and external use

The role averages approximately 20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams.

You will receive ongoing coaching, including support from a counsellor and buddy.

To learn more about our various teams within EY-Parthenon, please visit our [career page](https://www.ey.com/en_dk/careers/graduate-in-strategy-and-transactions).

## What we look for

* Individuals with a commercial mindset, strong interpersonal skills and an interest in understanding and communicating investment opportunities
* Curiosity, initiative and a willingness to learn
* Strong analytical capabilities and attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset

## Qualifications:

* You have recently started a relevant Master's degree or have at one year remaining of your Bachelor's degree
* An impressive academic record, a strong personal drive and an eye for detail
* Genuine interest in M&A, investments and corporate finance
* Structured, analytical and able to navigate complex business situations

## What’s in it for you

Joining EY-Parthenon Corporate Finance means becoming part of a collaborative team working on high-profile M&A transactions. You will gain practical experience in investment banking while developing highly valued skills. We offer:

* Structured learning and mentorship for professional and personal growth
* Exposure to international projects, providing a global perspective on deals
* Opportunities to take responsibility early, supported by experienced colleagues
* A professional yet informal work environment, where high standards coexist with teamwork and a positive atmosphere

## What you can expect

**Application deadline: 25 October 2026**.

The application process consists of the following steps:

1. Application**:** Upload your CV and latest grade transcript.
2. Assessment**:** After we receive your application, you’ll get an assessment link within a few days. It takes about 20 minutes to finish.
3. Video**:** After completing the assessment, you'll be asked to submit a short video about your motivation for this role.
4. Interview**:** Selected candidates are invited to face-to-face interviews on a rolling basis

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

For questions, contact Sarah Fenger at +45 2529 6892 (Copenhagen) and Peter Thrane-Jæger at +45 2529 6480 (Aarhus).

To help create an equitable and inclusive recruitment experience, please let us know if you require any accommodation during the recruitment process.
